assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0, the Helm chart now quotes nodeSelector values when it renders them; this is listed as a bugfix.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence says 'nodeSelector values in Helm Chart' but doesn't name which values keys are affected. The chart may have nodeSelector keys for several components (controller, webhook, cainjector, startupapicheck), and the evidence doesn't confirm which ones.; consequence: The release note only says nodeSelector values are now quoted. It doesn't say what failed before or what changes for operators after the upgrade.
